# openinfra_stream (Resource)

Change data capture from a database into NATS JetStream — the Kinesis-shaped primitive. Consume it from a `openinfra_function` with a `trigger`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `source` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass for this resource's persistent volumes. Defaults to `longhorn`; set to your cluster's StorageClass on substrates without Longhorn (e.g. RKE2 with local-path).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `phase` (String)
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
- `stream` (String) The JetStream stream backing this resource.
- `subjects` (String) The subject wildcard change events publish to.

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Required:

- `database` (String)
- `engine` (String) One of `postgres`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `sqlserver`.
- `host` (String) Hostname or Service name.
- `password_secret_ref` (Attributes) Secret holding the password. The password itself is never in this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--password_secret_ref))
- `username` (String)

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Defaults to `5432`.
- `replica_set` (String) MongoDB only. Defaults to `rs0`.
- `schemas` (List of String) Defaults to `["public"]`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `tables` (List of String) Tables or collections to capture, bare names. Empty means all.

<a id="nestedatt--source--password_secret_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.password_secret_ref`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `key` (String) Defaults to `password`.
